engine.notes: Oakland improv means All Out Comedy in Uptown and Pan Theater downtown, with Berkeley's Provocation Theatre, Berkeley Rep's school and The Marsh a few BART stops away. San Francisco's big schools (BATS, Endgames, Leela) draw East Bay students but are not listed here; Stone Soup Improv's Berkeley site no longer resolves.

entries.name: All Out Comedy Theater
entries.summary: Oakland's improv theater and training center on Telegraph Avenue, with a five-level improv track up to Chicago long form, four levels of musical improv, teen, sketch, clowning and stand-up classes, weekly shows and two recurring jams.
entries.schedule: Jam 2nd and 4th Wed 7pm $5; Musical Jam 1st and 3rd Sun 4:30pm; Knockoff Broadway 2nd and 4th Sat; Level 3 starts Sep 15
signals: Levels 1-5 plus four musical improv levels
entries.reasons: A permanent Uptown theater, the deepest class ladder in the East Bay, weekly shows and jams on a dated calendar; a founding year is not stated, which keeps the longevity score modest.

entries.name: Pan Theater
entries.summary: An improv theater and school in Oakland's theater district since 2002, next to 12th Street BART, teaching small-group classes with a free trial and staging shows such as Shaun Landry's September 2026 run.
entries.schedule: Shows Sep 18-19 2026 8pm $20; Improv 101 and Improv from the Heart classes with free trial
entries.reasons: Twenty-four years in the same downtown space with an adult class programme, but the site publishes neither class dates nor a regular show night.

entries.name: Berkeley Rep School of Theatre (Adult Improv)
entries.summary: Berkeley Repertory Theatre's school runs a three-tier adult improv sequence each term, from Beginning Improv through Intermediate to an Advanced Improv Performance Lab, plus a Dungeons & Dragons improv class.
entries.schedule: Beginning Thu from Sep 24 2026; Intermediate Mon from Sep 28 2026 ($380); Advanced Lab Tue from Sep 29 2026
entries.reasons: An institution with dated, levelled improv classes four times a year, but it is a drama school rather than an improv theater, with no shows or jams of its own.

entries.name: Provocation Theatre
entries.summary: A boutique improv theatre on Bancroft Way founded in 2023, with core classes, four house teams including BIPOC, queer and 49-plus ensembles, and a full October 2026 calendar of shows.
entries.schedule: Ten shows in Oct 2026 (Fridays and Saturdays 8pm, some Sundays); classes enrolling for Oct-Nov
signals: House teams Mothership, Globalls, All Queer No Fear, The Niners
entries.reasons: A dedicated room, house teams and a dated show calendar earn it well; it is three years old and its class levels are not spelled out on the site.

entries.name: The Marsh Berkeley: Improv On Demand
entries.summary: A first-Monday improv night at The Marsh Berkeley cabaret: an hour of unscripted show followed by a guided improv jam open to anyone in the room, on a sliding scale.
entries.schedule: First Mondays 7:30pm, show then jam 8:45-9:30pm; sliding scale $10-25; next Oct 5 2026
signals: Permanent page on The Marsh's site
entries.reasons: A reliable monthly fixture with its own page and a jam anyone can join, but it is one night a month with no classes.

entries.name: Joya Cory: Full Spectrum Improvisation
entries.summary: Physical-theatre improvisation classes from a long-time Bay Area teacher: a twice-monthly Saturday intermediate and advanced class at Wildcat Studio, a one-day fundamentals workshop and a weekly online class.
entries.schedule: Saturdays 1-4:30pm Sep 19-Dec 12 2026 (two a month); Fundamentals day Oct 25 2026 $80; online Wednesdays
entries.reasons: A current, dated programme from an established teacher, but a single-teacher studio with no performance side or levelled ladder.

entries.name: Oaktown Improv
entries.summary: A community improv group that runs weekly online jams, a monthly Zoom show and a monthly in-person Sunday jam at Montclair Presbyterian, with sliding-scale drop-in classes for people who have done an intro course.
entries.schedule: In-person jam Sun Oct 18 2026 1:30pm; online show 2nd Saturdays 8pm $5 (Oct 10 2026); online games jam Fri Oct 2 2026
entries.reasons: Current dates and a welcoming jam, but most of it happens on Zoom and there is no venue, levelled classes or live house show.

entries.name: Improv Central
entries.summary: A storefront studio on Central Avenue teaching improv for everyday confidence and connection rather than the stage, through drop-in and multi-week classes sold by the class or by monthly membership.
entries.schedule: Drop-in and multi-week classes; $49 two-week unlimited trial, $139 a month unlimited
entries.reasons: A real room and an active site, but no published dates, no levels leading anywhere and no shows.
